description: Ownership reference set: 38 documents checked on 2026-10-20 and 2026-10-21 (the same documents as the other reference sets; drafts still being written are left out). Items are material owned by non-Contributors. weight: whole figure or word-for-word passage 1.0; adapted figure, close paraphrase or unconfirmed origin 0.5. cited: complete credit (title, author, source, licence) 1.0; partial (right source, but no licence, author or quotation marks) 0.5; none or wrong source 0. Clip art and icons, contributing Members' own material, and reworded ideas are excluded. Ownership score = total weight per 1,000 words; poorly cited ownership score = total weight x (1 - cited) per 1,000 words.

class_rule.note: Poorly cited ownership is classed by a fixed rule, not by the mean and standard deviation of the reference set: good = no poorly cited material (score 0), bad = above 0.15 per 1,000 words (roughly one word-for-word passage with no credit per 6,700 words), improving = in between. Set by Hugo Vaughan on 2026-10-21 at 0.2 per 1,000 words (was above 2.0 per 10,000 words); lowered to 0.15 by Hugo Vaughan on 2026-10-23. Good widened by Hugo Vaughan on 2026-11-05 to a score up to 0.05 per 1,000 words, as long as no whole figure or word-for-word passage (weight 1.0) has no credit at all: with good = 0 only, every good document was short, because a long document almost never scores exactly 0.
